translated_title: Mexico Should Not Be a Data Center for Other Places, Because It Requires a Lot of Energy and Water, Sheinbaum Says
original_title: México no debe ser centro de datos de otros lugares, porque requiere mucha energía y agua: Sheinbaum
author: Arturo Sánchez Jiménez
meta_description: Sheinbaum said data centers should serve Mexico's own AI, not other countries, with the power that runs them kept under public-sector control.
